title: intents.list
description: Return persisted gap records (things Aether could not do), newest-first. Params: { limit?: number (default 100, max 1000), status?: 'open' | 'closed' | 'all' (default 'open') }. Returns { gaps: [{ id, ts, text, context, status }], counts: { open, closed } } where ts is an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, context is a string or null, and counts always reflects the whole log regardless of the status filter.
